key_insight: A hybrid symbolic, numerical, and physics-informed neural network framework computes and visualizes geodesics and geodesic spheres for the metric g = diag(1, x², 1), x > 0.
engineering_relevance: The workflow supports checking neural differential-equation solvers against numerical integration while visualizing geometry-dependent trajectories.
method: Symbolically compute Christoffel symbols, curvature tensors, and geodesic equations.
Solve geodesic equations using SciPy integration and a PINN, then compare solutions.
Visualize geodesic spheres and estimate intrinsic area and volume with grid-refinement checks.
evidence_signal: For a radius-one geodesic ball, base-grid area and volume estimates were approximately 0.362% and 0.364% below Euclidean values; the abstract reports no quantitative PINN accuracy.
watch_item: This metric is locally flat, so coordinate distortion and numerical estimation errors should not be interpreted as evidence of intrinsic curvature.
paper_title: A Physics-Informed Neural Network for Geodesic Computation and Visualization of Geodesic Spheres on Riemannian Manifolds
